summary: The change adds method="post" to the authentication form without altering the JavaScript-intercepted login flow.

evidence: public/index.html:111 now declares method="post" on #auth-form, so a native submission sends the email and password fields in the request body rather than the URL query string.
public/auth.js:511-512 still calls preventDefault() in the submit listener, preserving the interactive API-driven authentication path.
